- [SpareXpress Auto POS](https://wangamalinda.github.io/SpareXpress-Auto/): Point-of-sale and inventory system for a live automotive parts business (JavaScript, HTML/CSS).
- [QhaWear](https://www.qhawear.com/): Fashion brand storefront and product showcase site.
- [Food Paleis](https://wangamalinda.github.io/Food-Paleis/): Food ordering and showcase site with a dashboard-style interface.
